
# MarinaX - Project Instructions

## General Rules
- Always inspect the existing code before making changes.
- Respect the current architecture and coding conventions.
- Never assume a feature is missing without checking.
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies.
- Preserve existing functionality.
- Do not expose secrets or credentials.

## Multi-Agent Collaboration
- The Manager is responsible for coordinating all work.
- Specialists must return findings and implementation reports.
- Every task must have a clear scope and acceptance criteria.
- Avoid overlapping file modifications.
- Share API contracts and database decisions before integration.
- Do not overwrite another agent's changes.

## Git Rules
- Never commit directly to main.
- Never force push.
- Never merge without reviewing changes.
- Do not delete branches or worktrees without approval.

## Testing
- Run relevant tests after implementation.
- Run the production build when applicable.
- Report actual test results.
- Never claim tests passed without executing them.

## Documentation
- Keep PROJECT_CONTEXT.md updated when architecture changes.
- Keep DEVELOPMENT_STATUS.md updated after completed features.
- Document API contract changes.
